blurb: Guests embark on guided fishing tours targeting Pacific salmon, halibut, and other species in the Northern Strait of Georgia and West Coast Vancouver Island. Wildlife and coastal tours explore areas like Desolation Sound, Denman and Hornby Islands, and remote inlets with opportunities to see whales, bears, and other wildlife. Trips are customizable and include experienced captains on Transport Canada certified vessels.
